changes.title: Budai's Heavy Adjudicators are valued like vanilla's own
changes.why: Vanilla values this same gun at 100,000, and at the mod's 500,000 the pair sold for 7.5 million in Survival.
changes.before: Base value 500,000; sells for about 3,750,000 each before tariff
changes.after: Base value 100,000; sells for about 750,000 each before tariff

changes.title: Sanzu's planetary wakes hold three wrecks, not six
changes.why: Six certain derelicts against vanilla Survival's 0.1 recoverable weight.
changes.before: Two recoverable wrecks per Silent Wake planet
